source: Actual lecture pages inspected; independently coded from persisted pre-key reasoning, not author scripts.

checks.name: Two-branch planar IK reconstructs complete pose
checks.detail: 1000 seeded nondegenerate targets, two independently reconstructed elbow/shoulder/wrist solutions each.

checks.name: Boundary elbow coalescence
checks.detail: Outer and nonzero inner annulus boundaries; plus/minus zero sine correspond to the same elbow rotation modulo2π.

checks.name: Equal-link origin continuous family
checks.detail: Arbitrary shoulder with folded elbow and compensating wrist reconstructs zero translation and desired orientation.

checks.name: Length domains and unreachable annulus
checks.detail: Zero/negative lengths rejected; inner hole and beyond outer radius both unreachable.

checks.name: Corrected normalized x expansion
checks.detail: Correct cosine-sum identity holds; printed repeated-cosine factor is not used.

checks.name: P0284-Q03 distractor values
checks.detail: o3 changes the first θ factor and subtraction sign; its second sinγ sinθ1 product is already the correct factor, disproving “both original factors changed incorrectly”.

checks.name: Homogeneity counterexample
checks.detail: f(3)=6; printed RHS3; repaired RHS6, exact integers.

checks.name: Tall and wide full-rank shortcuts
checks.detail: 500 seeded3×2 matrices and their2×3 transposes; compare independent formulas and identity products to SVD pseudoinverse.

checks.name: Rank-deficient pseudoinverse exists while Gram inverse fails
checks.detail: Dependent columns yield singular Gram matrix but satisfy Moore–Penrose reconstruction with SVD.

checks.name: Wide minimum-norm example and distinct options
checks.detail: Every exact solution[1+t,1−t] has squared norm2+2t²; only[1,1] minimizes it. Other choices are distinct.

checks.name: Differential-drive ranks and feasible-rate inverse
checks.detail: Positive radius/half-track maintain rank2 including90°; signed wheel rates reconstruct yaw and world translation.

testDevelopmentNote: The initial floating-point endpoint test produced ±2.98e-8 sine for the exact inner radius with lengths0.4,3.7 because computed c2 was−0.9999999999999996. The test helper now snaps c2 to an endpoint only within1e-12, distinguishing roundoff from a new physical branch. No authored question content changed.
limitations: No numerical question generator or runtime robot is claimed. These are mathematical checks for34 fixed review items; no instantiated variants are present.
